title: Object-Oriented Solidity
learning_outcomes: Explain the main ideas in Object-Oriented Solidity and correctly use the key terms in context.
Build or inspect a minimal Solidity example that demonstrates the lesson concepts.
Test representative failure cases and describe version, security, or operational assumptions where relevant.

overview_visual.alt_text: A two-column ordered roadmap for Module 9: Object-Oriented Solidity; it lists all 13 source-syllabus lesson topics by number.
overview_visual.caption: Module 9 roadmap: Contracts as Encapsulated Units of State and Behavior; Inheritance Fundamentals; Single and Multiple Inheritance; Method Resolution and Linearization; Constructors in Inheritance; Abstract Contracts; Interfaces; External Contract References; Libraries and Reusable Code; Using and Importing External Source Files; Namespaces and Import Aliases; Composition Versus Inheritance; Designing Maintainable Contract Systems. Work through the topics in order, then implement a small example and verify assumptions.

notes: Preserves numbered syllabus topics 103–115 from the attached Solidity PDF. Track: core. All content is draft pending subject-matter review.
